name: Mangi-Tungi
description: Mangi-Tungi is a sacred twin peak located in Nashik district and is one of the most important Jain pilgrimage sites in India. Known for its 4500+ carved steps and the world's tallest Jain statue of Lord Rishabhdev (108 ft), the climb is both physically demanding and spiritually significant.

routes.name: Taharabad Steps Route
routes.description: More than 4500 stone steps carved into the mountain, leading to both Mangi and Tungi peaks.

landmarks.name: 108 ft Rishabhdev Statue
landmarks.description: World's tallest Jain statue located at base.

landmarks.name: Rock-Cut Jain Idols
landmarks.description: Hundreds of ancient Jain carvings along the route.

landmarks.name: Twin Peaks (Mangi & Tungi)
landmarks.description: Two separate summits offering panoramic views.

onFort.name: Jain Bhojan
onFort.description: Simple sattvik food available at base.

history.brief: Mangi-Tungi has been an important Jain pilgrimage site for centuries.
history.significance: Houses the world's tallest Jain statue and hundreds of rock-cut idols.
